title: Payout Methods Earnings Release and Withholding Rates
content:
The timing and make-up of the earnings released to Payout Methods, and the US tax withholding rates that may be taken from them, are the same on all six rails.

## Release figures (every rail: Direct Deposit (ACH), Fast Pay Debit Card, PayPal, Payoneer, International Wire Transfer, Western Union Cash Pickup)

| Item | Value on every rail |
|---|---|
| Release time | 24 elapsed hours after the start of the check-in date |
| Monthly-installment stays | Each monthly installment's earnings released 24 hours after the start of the first night it covers |
| Earnings released for a stay | The stay's nightly subtotal, cleaning fee, pet fee total and extra-guest fee total, less the host service fee |

## Withholding figures (every rail)

| Item | Value on every rail |
|---|---|
| Backup withholding: a US host without a W-9 on file | 24.00% of released earnings |
| Nonresident withholding: a non-US host without a W-8 on file | 30.00% of released earnings |
| Amount withholding is computed on | The earnings released for the stay or installment, before payout-method fees |

## Points of reference

- The 24-hour release time runs from the **start** of the check-in date, not from the guest's arrival time.
- Withholding is computed on released earnings **before** payout-method fees, so a rail's transfer fee does not reduce the amount the percentage applies to.

**Hypothetical illustration of the rates.** For an imagined release of USD 800.00, 24.00% is USD 192.00 and 30.00% is USD 240.00.
